remarks: Welcome to Glenwood Commons! This bright 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom ground floor condo offers comfortable, low maintenance living in a convenient Norwalk location. Freshly painted with all new appliances, the unit features a spacious open living and dining area, generous bedroom with walk-in closet, and private balcony. Includes an assigned parking space and attached one car garage with additional storage. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, beaches, Metro-North, Route 7, and I-95. Move-in ready!
